mentions.name: Mojave Paint
mentions.description: Mojave Paint is a commercial Mac app image editor positioned as a competitor to Photoshop and Affinity Photo, built by a small indie shop.
mentions.source_excerpt: Jumping into this "handcrafted with love by a small indie shop" landscape of commercial Mac apps, with Mojave Paint, my Photoshop and Affinity Photo competitor. https://mojavepaint.app
mentions.author: jpsimons
